note: OMIM entry and clinical synopsis for SCA52 (OMIM #621535) caused by RAB3A explicitly include spastic paraplegia in the clinical phenotype spectrum.

evidence.text: The OMIM clinical synopsis for Spinocerebellar Ataxia 52 (SCA52) lists spastic paraplegia as a clinical feature associated with pathogenic variants in RAB3A.

source.title: SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 52; SCA52 - Clinical Synopsis
source.quote: SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 52; SCA52. INHERITANCE ... - Spastic paraplegia ... - Caused by mutation in the RAS-associated protein RAB3A gene (RAB3A, 179490.0001).

evidence.text: Recent literature notes that spinocerebellar ataxias encompass a spectrum ranging from pure ataxia to complex phenotypes, with SCA52 identified as caused by heterozygous mutations in RAB3A.

source.title: From genes to neuropathology: Integrative perspectives on the spectrum of spinocerebellar ataxias
